This small plot of a quarter hectare is where I grow my beans, and beans do not demand as much fertilizer as maize because they fix their own nitrogen in the soil. I have some cattle manure from home, so I will spread that on the plot before planting — it is cheaper than buying fertilizer from the trading centre. I will plant the local bean seed I saved from last season; the improved varieties are too expensive at the agro-dealer and I trust what has grown well here before. The plot is close to the homestead so my wife and children will help with weeding and harvest, and I do not need to hire anyone for such a small piece of land.
